title: GovernanceBinding
description: Records the governance files read and hashes at portfolio/plan initialization time.

binding_id.description: Stable SHA-256-derived identifier for this governance binding.

bound_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the binding was created.

governance_files.description: List of governance files read and their SHA-256 content hashes.

canonical_plan_location.description: Repo-relative path where plans must reside (e.g. plans/.claude/).

plan_schema.description: Repo-relative path to the plan JSON schema, if it exists.

state_store.description: Repo-relative path to the supervisor state store (e.g. .local/supervisor/).

execution_controller.description: Repo-relative path to the autonomous execution controller script.
